notes: Selects curated Protomaps island source assertions, then materialises the SaanSeoi landform identity and area companions.

mergeRules.condition: Every selected island geometry must have an accepted curation decision in fixtures/meta/curations/saanseoi-island-review.json; new names and newly available geometry block assembly.

mappings.from: uncurated name, geometry or ambiguous match
mappings.to: block assembly and retain the curation evidence

en.description: Selects only curated Protomaps island features and blocks assembly when a name or geometry needs curation.

zh-hant.description: 只選取已整理的 Protomaps 島嶼要素；名稱或幾何需要整理時會停止組裝。

zh-hans.description: 只选取已整理的 Protomaps 岛屿要素；名称或几何需要整理时会停止组装。

mergeRules.sourceFieldPath: curated Protomaps island selections, curated Overture and LandsD crosswalks
mergeRules.condition: Retain an Overture Division ID when a curated crosswalk exists; otherwise derive the stable SaanSeoi island ID.

mappings.to: SaanSeoi Division identity and membership provenance
SaanSeoi Division official-name and alias provenance

en.description: Materialises each curated island as a SaanSeoi landform Division, retaining an Overture identity when available.

zh-hant.description: 將每個已整理島嶼實體化為 SaanSeoi 地貌區劃，並在可用時保留 Overture 身分。

zh-hans.description: 将每个已整理岛屿实体化为 SaanSeoi 地貌区划，并在可用时保留 Overture 身份。

mergeRules.condition: Use the selected Protomaps polygon as the SaanSeoi land area without unioning it with Overture geometry.

en.description: Materialises the selected Protomaps polygon as the SaanSeoi island DivisionArea without combining source geometries.

zh-hant.description: 將選定的 Protomaps 多邊形實體化為 SaanSeoi 島嶼區劃範圍，不合併來源幾何。

zh-hans.description: 将选定的 Protomaps 多边形实体化为 SaanSeoi 岛屿区划范围，不合并来源几何。
